title: Present verified protocols and source findings explicitly in the desktop UI

requirements.text: Label Results as verified Ethereum Mainnet protocols rather than generic research candidates once protocol-first discovery is active.
Show contract verification and source-analysis state separately from research-priority classification.
Surface source-analysis finding counts and high-review findings from each resolved protocol without describing heuristic findings as confirmed vulnerabilities.
Provide a direct View Findings action and a candidate-level security summary that explains evidence limitations.
Keep renderer enhancement CSP-compatible, fail-soft, DOM-safe, and compatible with the existing Electron preload bridge.
